go-01-c1.text: The Go Authors (2024). Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ). go.dev.
go-01-c1.quote: Robert Griesemer, Rob Pike and Ken Thompson started sketching the goals for a new language on the white board on September 21, 2007.
go-01-c1.claim: In 2007 Robert Griesemer, Rob Pike, and Ken Thompson started designing Go at Google.

go-01-c3.text: The Go Authors (2012). Go 1 Release Notes. go.dev.
go-01-c3.quote: In Go 1, the order in which elements are visited when iterating over a map using a for range statement is defined to be unpredictable, even if the same loop is run multiple times with the same map.
go-01-c3.claim: Map iteration order is randomized to discourage reliance on it.
